name: Padal proshlogodniy sneg 2
summary:
The Man is once again scolded by his Wife, who throws his magic wand out the window. The Man runs after it, but it turns out the wand hits a crow and transforms it into Zmey Gorynych, which carries the hero off to distant lands.

The Man must travel through a snowy forest and meet Baba Yaga, who sends him to the Thrice-Ninth Kingdom. There, the hero must follow the path of a tsarevich, infiltrate the castle of Koschei the Deathless, and finally return home, avoiding his злую Wife.

Standard point-and-click quest controls. Some inventory items can be combined, and the magic wand—always present in your inventory—can transform objects.
